tools.name: jumpPage
tools.description: Navigate the user to an in-app page. Allowed pages: home (首页), students (学生管理), admin-roles (角色管理, admin only), admin-users (用户管理, admin only), admin-kb (RAG/知识库管理, admin only). Use the slug exactly as listed.

tools.name: createStudent
tools.description: Open the create-student form on the Students page. Optional prefill fields: student_no (学号), name (姓名), class_name (班级), status (active=在读, inactive=休学). Does NOT submit the form; the user must click Save in the UI.
